subject: Demo summary + success playbook -> proposed POC milestones for MeridianEdge
messages:
From: Eli Torres <eli@meridianedge.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Lin <samantha.lin@meridianedge.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up from today's demo — POC goals

Hannah — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap from our side and a few asks so we can move toward a formal POC: 

Summary of needs:
- Use case: customer support triage + assisted reply generation across e-mail and chat.
- Performance targets: median single-turn latency under 200ms at 90th percentile; sustained embedding throughput ~1k/s for search index refresh.
- Data & security: SOC 2 required; data retention configurable to 30 days; private VPC deployment preferred (initial POC can run in your Dedicated or Private offering).
- Success signals: 1) precision of triage suggestions >= 85% vs. our gold labels, 2) end-to-end latency under 250ms in 95% of calls, 3) integration with our embedding-based search returns relevant results + clear cost/per-token estimates.

Next asks from us:
1) A short POC plan with milestones, roles, and acceptance gates we can show our execs.
2) Network & onboarding checklist so our infra team can pre-clear ports/KMS access.
3) Rough resource estimate (GPU profile + duration) and any temporary credits for validation.

Target timeline: we want to kick off the POC the week of May 3 if possible (2–4 week POC).

Appreciate it — copying Samantha (prod lead) who will coordinate schedules.

— Eli
Eli Torres
VP of Engineering, MeridianEdge
eli@meridianedge.com
+1 (415) 555-0182
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eli Torres <eli@meridianedge.com>
Cc: Samantha Lin <samantha.lin@meridianedge.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 18:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from today's demo — POC goals

Eli — great to hear the priorities laid out clearly, and appreciate the perf targets. Below is a concise POC playbook we propose (attached: meridianedge_poc_playbook_v1.pdf) plus the network checklist (network_requirements_v1.xlsx). I captured owners and acceptance gates so you can show this to your execs.

Proposed POC (3-week baseline, can expand to 4 weeks if needed)
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff, 3 business days): account provisioning, network allowlist, KMS agreement, quick configuration call. Owners: Hannah (sales lead), Ben (solutions engineering), Rajiv (privacy at MeridianEdge) — please confirm Rajiv as the privacy reviewer.
- Week 1 (integration & ingestion): seed dataset, generate embeddings, validate embedding recall on sample queries. Acceptance gate: embedding recall >= 0.65 on prioritized queries. Owner: Ben.
- Week 2 (latency & quality validation): run production-like traffic profile (synthetic ramp to 1k embedding ops/s), measure latency and output quality vs. your gold labels. Acceptance gates: median latency <200ms; quality metric >=85%. Owner: Monica (CS lead) will coordinate human evaluation.
- Week 3 (iteration & handoff): make model/config changes, finalize monitoring & cost dashboard, agree on next steps (Dedicated capacity quote or Private deployment).

Success criteria (what we recommend you sign off on):
1) Accuracy: triage suggestion precision >=85% on your labeled set.
2) Latency: p95 <250ms for single-turn inference when testing under expected load.
3) Cost visibility: token/embedding unit cost estimate and an agreed resource plan.
4) Security: SOC 2 evidence + network/KMS configuration validated.

Deliverables we'll provide:
- POC playbook PDF (attached)
- Network & onboarding checklist (attached)
- Small evaluation harness (Jupyter notebook) and example queries for your team
- 2-week usage credit estimate for the trial period (Ben will confirm GPU sizing & cost)

Next steps / asks for MeridianEdge:
- Confirm Rajiv (privacy reviewer) and a 60-minute kickoff slot the week of May 3 — we suggested Tues 5/4 or Wed 5/5.
- Approve the playbook PDF so we can lock dates and resources.

If that aligns, I will loop Ben and Monica to confirm resource sizing and scheduling.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick follow-up from today's demo — POC goals

Ben / Monica — forwarding Eli's note + my proposed playbook. Please see quick asks below so we can reply to MeridianEdge by EOD: 

Ben — can you confirm the GPU profile we'd recommend for a 3-week POC that sustains ~1k embedding ops/s and supports low-latency chat? Also include a rough cost estimate and whether we can provide a short-term usage credit for validation.

Monica — can you confirm you'll own the human-eval acceptance gate and the monitoring dashboard setup? I propose we create a simple acceptance rubric (precision thresholds, latency thresholds, and a small sample of curated queries).

Attachments: meridianedge_poc_playbook_v1.pdf, network_requirements_v1.xlsx (attached to customer thread).

Thanks — if we can get answers this morning I'll send an updated calendar invite and kickoff agenda to Eli.

— Hannah

Hannah — this looks good and we are aligned to proceed. Confirming a few points:

3) Monica: draft acceptance rubric and one sample evaluation job for our review.
4) Hannah: final POC playbook file and network checklist (attach latest versions).

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

— Eli
